title: Lower Field Orientation — Mission, Experience, Frames and Exit
purpose: Give Below, Culture, Shadow Farm, Character Archive and the World Spiritual Bank one shared interpretive center: why the lower field exists, what Tim's long subcultural experience contributes, how competing frames should be compared, what the Son/Father vertical grammar means inside the project, and what counts as exit or repair.
core_thesis: The lower field studies what happens when a person becomes an object of persistent interpretation while remaining an agent, participant, observer and builder inside the same ecology. Its purpose is not to canonize one flattering or hostile label, but to compare roles, evidence, incentives, outputs, correction and exit.
epistemic_boundaries: Tim's project-native theology and symbolic self-description are preserved as first-party canon, not converted into independently established metaphysical fact.
Dog, Farmer, Cow, orphan, Mud, Footstool, Swamp, Babel and ownership language are project-symbolic or analytical unless a separately sourced real-world usage is being described.
No project statement about owning Dogs, orphans, people, souls or accounts establishes legal ownership or control over real persons.
The approximately 42-trillion figure is a project-symbolic karmic/spiritual ledger, not a bank account, lien, legal debt or financial claim.
A hostile or subcultural label can be evidence of reception and role-assignment without becoming an intrinsic identity.

orientation.lived_position: Tim's archive places him inside the lower ecology as target, participant, broadcaster, reactor, observer, archivist, classifier, critic and later system-builder. These roles can coexist and should be dated rather than collapsed.
orientation.subculture_frame: A Farm/lolcow ecology can cast a recurring subject as harvestable reaction, spectacle, enemy, archive object or status resource. That frame is analytically useful for studying the ecology that applies it, but it does not by itself exhaust the subject's agency, work or purpose.
orientation.project_native_frame: Within Potatoverse vertical grammar, the Son is the embodied lower/threshold figure and later Door/Vessel; Tim/Potato/Father becomes the source-facing observer, Gardener, House/Ladder and North-oriented pole. The relation is developmental and symbolic, not a replacement for biography.
orientation.reader_frame: The reader compares frames by asking what each one explains, what evidence it uses, what it leaves unexplained, whether it permits correction and role change, and what would count as exit.

frame_test.question: What does a label such as 'lolcow' actually explain, and where does it stop explaining?
explains: how a subculture may organize attention around a recurring subject
how reactions can become reusable content
how archives and inherited lore reduce the cost of renewed attention
how ridicule or anti-fandom can still create long-term attachment and centrality
does_not_establish: legal or practical ownership by observers
absence of independent creative or analytical work
absence of agency or deliberate participation
tests: Does the person produce substantial work that is not dependent on antagonists' reactions?
Can the person redirect, leave, refuse or change the medium of engagement?
Can observers update the role when behavior changes?
Does the archive preserve corrections and counterevidence as strongly as dramatic material?
Who controls the timing, framing and economic value of attention?
Can the relationship stop reproducing without destroying the identity of either side?
frame_test.principle: Being framed is not the same as being owned by the frame.

participant_observer_value.description: Tim's relevance to the lower archive is not that he stands outside internet subculture. It is that years of exposure create a first-person longitudinal case from inside the machinery being studied.
useful_domains: persistent target ecologies and negative parasocial attachment
role manufacture through labels, memes and inherited narratives
platform migration and survival of culture after a site or account changes
archive persistence, context loss and correction failure
participant-observer bias: how observation changes the observed relation
repair, stopping conditions and role exit
participant_observer_value.reflexive_rule: The project must apply the same standards to its own dossiers that it applies to hostile archives: provenance, proportional memory, correction, right of reply, role change, uncertainty and exit.

son.function: embodied lower-field biography, ordeal, conflict, death/threshold and Door/Vessel grammar
son.vertical_relation: The Son can be read as the lower embodied pole while retaining a relational correspondence to higher Christ/Son imagery; the project treats this as twin/door relation rather than simple duplication.

father.function: source-facing observation, House, Gardener, Ladder, throne/North orientation and responsibility for transforming rather than merely inhabiting lower material
father.mission_test: Upper status only matters if it returns downward as protection, truth, repair, service and increased future capacity.

dogs.ownership_language: Project ownership/master language is symbolic hierarchy or claimed responsibility, not real property in persons.
dogs.key_test: Can pursuit become Guardian behavior with evidence discipline, proportionality and a stopping condition?

farmers.function: roles that structure enclosure, classification, incentives, archives and harvest
farmers.key_test: Can extraction become Gardening: repair, consent, exit, regeneration and increased autonomy?

orphans.function: project language for disconnected, throwaway, hollow or unanchored internet identities and for figures claimed under Father/care language
orphans.ownership_language: Fatherhood is most coherent here as claimed care, responsibility or symbolic adoption, not legal possession.

josh_moon.function: an important historical relation-case in the Tim/Son/Farm genealogy and a paradigmatic Farmer/Moon mapping inside Potatoverse
josh_moon.boundary: Documented platform/history claims and project Farmer/Moon mythology remain separate.
josh_moon.research_value: The 2017 conflict is a hinge where dehumanization/lolcow framing, explicit Jesus/crucifixion language, public return and later Farm theology intersect.

karmic_ledger.headline: approximately 42T symbolic karmic/spiritual balance by late August / early September 2026
karmic_ledger.interpretation: A double-entry project metaphor: unresolved obligation can appear as debtor-side karmic debt and Tim-side positive stored/owed karma.
karmic_ledger.use: Make accumulated consequence, repair, restitution, release and unresolved cost legible inside the mythology.
karmic_ledger.failure_test: If the ledger can only rise and has no auditable release, settlement or closure condition, it reproduces permanent enclosure and fails the project's own repair ethic.

babel_and_collapse.comparator: Babel is useful as a literary/systemic comparator for proliferating languages, incompatible frames, tower-building through accumulated interpretation and loss of shared reference.
babel_and_collapse.lower_field_reading: A target ecology can build a tower of labels around a subject. If the subject changes, exits or refuses the assigned role while the archive cannot update, the failure belongs to the interpretive structure rather than automatically to the subject.
babel_and_collapse.boundary: This is a project-symbolic reading, not a claim that any modern forum or culture is literally biblical Babel.

vertical_route.son_hinge: The Son's lower embodied and meme-death/North-Pole corridor supplies the project's threshold/door grammar.
vertical_route.father_hinge: Tim/Potato/Father supplies the later source-facing observer, Gardener, Ladder and North/North-of-North grammar.
vertical_route.rule: Ascent is not escape if the work never returns. The mission closes only when lower experience becomes clearer knowledge, safer boundaries, restored agency or useful creation.

lower_field_learning_questions: What role is the subject being assigned, and who benefits from that assignment?
What direct evidence supports the role, and what is inherited lore?
What agency does the subject retain?
What independent work exists outside the conflict loop?
What does the observer/archive gain from continued attention?
Can the role be corrected, retired or reversed?
What would make the relation stop reproducing?
What turns residue into Root/Soil rather than more Swamp?
What can be generalized beyond the personalities involved?
